name: com.toflaks.csv-pipeline
description: Bakes CSV rows into ScriptableObject assets on import, and optionally pulls those CSVs from Google Sheets. All baking runs in the Editor. The only assembly that ships with your build is a small one holding the [CsvAsset] attribute declarations — no executable code, and it does not even reference UnityEngine.

samples.description: The smallest example of one table becoming ScriptableObject assets. There is no importer code.
